purpose: Freeze the electrophysiology-only decision process used to select one prominence threshold per Figure 3C DNa02 channel before behavior is opened.
candidate_generation: Use thresholds already present in the authenticated prominence-audit receipt. Run peak detection once at the lowest candidate threshold, then obtain stricter candidate sets by filtering the same peak/prominence set.
event_rate_policy: Event rate is descriptive only and may not be the stated threshold-selection basis.
forbidden_actions: select a threshold because it improves Figure 3C fit
select a threshold because it improves odor-navigation performance
invent a threshold outside the frozen candidate set in v1
drop a Figure 3C fly based on downstream behavior
